nodes.name: relaunch

The generation counter advances at `currentGeneration` CauldronRegistry.sol:857 and the grace clock restarts at `lastSummonAt` CauldronRegistry.sol:858, before the new token exists. The proposer-supplied quote is narrowed twice and never allowed to revert: the allowlist re-check at `allowedQuote` CauldronRegistry.sol:915, then the mining fallback inside `_deployToken` CauldronRegistry.sol:934, then the funding narrowing in `seedFunding` CauldronRegistry.sol:966. `markConsumed` CauldronRegistry.sol:995 is placed after the only remaining revert, the zero-funding check at `totalETH` CauldronRegistry.sol:994, so the fatal window in which a revert would roll the consumption back is short. The quote actually achieved is recorded at `generationQuote` CauldronRegistry.sol:1000 and the funding figure it is denominated in comes from the PRIMARY pair's currency0 at `generationPoolKey` CauldronRegistry.sol:969, not from the generation-quote mapping. Reserve sizing folds the pending OG share in at `genesisPending` CauldronRegistry.sol:1019, clamps three ways at `newActive` CauldronRegistry.sol:1034, CauldronRegistry.sol:1061 and CauldronRegistry.sol:1074, and only then splits supply at `newReserve` CauldronRegistry.sol:1075. observations: comment at `Permissionless` CauldronRegistry.sol:777 says anyone can call once the pool is confirmed dead; code at `hasProposals` CauldronRegistry.sol:805 additionally requires a wired governor holding proposals, and `minLifetime` CauldronRegistry.sol:801 additionally requires the grace period to have elapsed.

comment at `NEVER` CauldronRegistry.sol:815 says a revert in the force-close step can never brick the rebirth; code at `forceClosePerps` CauldronRegistry.sol:1144 makes that call without a try/catch, and the note at `WRAPPED` CauldronRegistry.sol:1125 states the opposite, that letting it revert rolls the whole rebirth back.

comment at `CREATE` CauldronRegistry.sol:933 says the new generation's token is deployed with plain CREATE; code reached from `_deployToken` CauldronRegistry.sol:934 deploys it with CREATE2 from a mined salt at `salt` PoolOps.sol:707, using plain CREATE only in the unmined fallback at `CauldronToken` PoolOps.sol:718.

When the cap check fails because `g` CauldronRegistry.sol:1143 is below the reserve, the close is skipped entirely and the rebirth continues with the book untouched (DERIVED).
